- Added 5 test files (120 tests total, `npm test` green): `matrixService.test.ts`, `matrixController.test.ts`, `matrixPage.test.ts`, `app.test.ts` (unit tests per module) and `matrixApi.test.ts` (supertest HTTP/integration tests against the assembled app, covering invalid cells, overflow, and size limits).
- Added `GET /api/matrix/sum` (`sumCells` in `matrixService.ts`, route in `matrixController.ts`), with unit + controller + integration tests.
- Ran mutation testing via the mutagate skill: `matrixController.ts` and `matrixPage.ts` hit 100%, `matrixService.ts` 0.96, `app.ts` 0.96 — all above the 0.80 gate. Strengthened tests with exact error-message assertions to kill most survivors; the 6 remaining are genuinely equivalent/unreachable mutants (a dead second bounds-check in `cellIndex`, an unobservable `.slice()` in `snapshot`, and an Express quirk where `''` and `'/'` route identically — verified empirically). Filed waivers with reasons for human review rather than weakening production code.
